Creates a new raster on a grid defined by its bounds, cell size and reference system, with a constant or random value.

**Toolbox folder:** Raster Processing<br>
**Status:** Certified<br>
**Keywords:** Raster, Generator, Grid, Random<br>
**Authors:** Andrea Antonello, Silvia Franceschi<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.RasterGenerator`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `pNorth` | Double |  |  | The north bound of the grid. |
| `pSouth` | Double |  |  | The south bound of the grid. |
| `pWest` | Double |  |  | The west bound of the grid. |
| `pEast` | Double |  |  | The east bound of the grid. |
| `pXres` | Double |  |  | The cell size in x. |
| `pYres` | Double |  |  | The cell size in y. |
| `pCode` | CRS code |  |  | The code defining the coordinate reference system, composed by authority and code number (ex. EPSG:32632). |
| `pValue` | double |  | `0` | The value of the cells. |
| `doRandom` | boolean |  | `false` | If true, the cells get random values instead of the constant one. |
| `pOffset` | double |  | `0` | The lowest random value. |
| `pScale` | double |  | `1.0` | The width of the range of the random values. |
| `pSeed` | Long |  |  | An optional seed, to get the same random values at every run. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outRaster` | output file |  | The generated raster. |
